importanceModel.source: College Board Digital SAT operational question distribution + mapped SAT question bank frequency
importanceModel.domainWeightNormalization: official domain weight / highest official domain weight in the same SAT section
importanceModel.topicFrequencyNormalization: mapped topic question count / highest mapped topic question count in the same content domain

questionInventory.selectionRule: Two text-only multiple-choice questions per Topic, preferring SAT question-bank sources, complete four-option sets, supplied explanations, and stable source order; selected questions are removed from standalone Quiz.

metadata.note: SAT package template generated from the complete Web exam-prep materials.

topics.title: Determining Word or Phrase Meaning from Context
topics.description: Determine the precise meaning of a word or phrase in a specific context based on contextual clues.

topics.title: Distinguishing Precision, Connotation, and Tone in Synonyms
topics.description: Compare differences in precision, emotional connotation, and tone among synonyms.

topics.title: Selecting Words Based on Context and Style
topics.description: Select the most appropriate words based on sentence meaning, register, and style.

topics.title: Identifying the Author's Main Purpose and Intent

topics.title: Identifying Text Organization, Argumentative Structure, and Rhetorical Strategies
